bundle.shortDescription: Visual manager for AI coding agent tools and session logs
bundle.longDescription: Echo Studio is a portable Windows desktop app that shows the skills, plugins, MCP servers, commands and agents your AI coding agent CLI uses, and lets you explore its session logs in a chat-style viewer.
